create_PyspielTensorGame: create a PyspielTensorGame instance from a pyspiel game string specifier and optional tensor_game flag
build_payoff_tensor: build a payoff tensor from a loaded pyspiel game by converting game payoffs to a numpy array
test_num_players: test the number of players in a PyspielTensorGame instance
test_num_strategies: test the number of strategies per player returned by num_strategies method
run_get_payoffs_for_strategies: run get_payoffs_for_strategies with a list of integer policy indices to retrieve player payoffs
